android.desc: Harmonic is a fully-featured, open-source, mature Hacker News client with a focus on (material) design, polish, and customization. Highlights • Material 3 Expressive design with smooth animations • Full login functionality (vote, comment, submit, favorite, etc.) • Strong theming support • Quality of life features such as reader mode, adblock, link previews • Excellent performance • A large collection of settings Harmonic has been developed over a long time and its main feature is the relentless polish and feature completeness it has accumulated. Harmonic for Hacker News is not affiliated with Y Combinator.
